description: This file contains common shell functions for upgrading OpenWRT firmware, including installation of files, running hooks, querying magic bytes of images, partition handling, and upgrade procedures.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to specified locations, handling symbolic links and creating necessary directories.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs an executable binary and its libraries.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no question if in interactive mode.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads data from a source, possibly decompressing based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Processes image data with dd, filtering out broken pipe messages.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the magic word of an image.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads a long magic value from an image.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads the GPT magic bytes.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads the VFAT magic bytes.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads the FAT32 magic bytes.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies image type based on magic bytes.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks for EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks for FAT or FAT32 partition magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Finds and exports the boot device based on system info.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports a specific partition device based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts little-endian 32-bit hex string to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table information from a device or file.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to indicate an upgrade.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade, optionally backing up.
